label: NO_REGISTERABLE_CANDIDATE_NOW
label_basis: evidence items (K1 headroom, K2 baseline, K3 channel bound) fail for every named candidate; no rule item alone blocks a candidate that would otherwise pass
missing_piece: a named organization operation with an a-priori mechanism prediction on a task with measured matched-control headroom
reopening_conditions: named manipulation with a one-sentence mechanism prediction and a control differing only in that quantity (K5/K7)
measured matched-control headroom with a derived delta_min; no same-family difficulty inflation (K1)
a valid bound on the representation-reachability difference, much smaller than delta_min, or the C7 representation-equivalence route (K3)
architecture-free baseline; the oracle arm stays diagnostic (K2)
preregistered levels, tolerances, sample sizes and power for every qualification gate; no label leakage (K8/K9)
self-bound frozen generality predicate and full axis disclosure (K6/K5)

tensions.name: representational content vs capacity channel
tensions.statement: a manipulation with representational content creates a projection-cost channel; a channel provably near zero leaves only optimization-path differences

tensions.name: capacity-type effect vs G1-MATCH-v3
tensions.statement: if the advantage comes from effective capacity, the declared consumed axis is capacity; matching that axis under v3 removes the advantage, so capacity-type effects are structurally inadmissible for Gate 1

tensions.name: headroom vs task degeneration
tensions.statement: constructing a task whose exact solution is not a low-dimensional smooth approximation tends to make information rather than organization the binding constraint, making the organization effect unattributable
